news.title: Suraj Industries Ltd (BSE:526211) entered into agreement to acquire 50.03% stake in VRV Foods Ltd for approximately INR 370 million.
news.body:
Suraj Industries Ltd (BSE:526211) entered into agreement to acquire 50.03% stake in VRV Foods Ltd for approximately INR 370 million on February 7, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 371.28 million valued at INR 66 per share will be paid by Suraj Industries Ltd. As part of consideration, INR 371.28 million is paid towards common equity of VRV Foods Ltd.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, VRV Foods Ltd reported total revenue of INR 1.23 billion and net income of INR 31.6 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer shareholders and approval of offer by acquirer board. The deal has been approved by the board. The expected completion of the transaction is financial years 2025–26 and 2026–27.

news.title: Suraj Industries Ltd (BSE:526211) completed the acquisition of an additional 9.69% stake in Carya Chemicals & Fertilizers Private Limited from Sarth Agbev and Energy Private Limited and Suraj Prakash Gupta.
news.body:
Suraj Industries Ltd (BSE:526211) signed a letter of intent to acquire an additional 9.69% stake in Carya Chemicals & Fertilizers Private Limited from Sarth Agbev and Energy Private Limited and Suraj Prakash Gupta for INR 80.4 million on July 28, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 80.37 million valued at INR 12.6 per share will be paid by Suraj Industries Ltd. Before completion, Upon completion, Suraj Industries Ltd owns 85.75% stake in Carya Chemicals & Fertilizers Private Limited. Suraj Industries Ltd will own 95.44% stake in Carya Chemicals & Fertilizers Private Limited. The agreement was signed on September 16, 2025. 

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Carya Chemicals & Fertilizers Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 0.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer
